summary: Iteration 65 - Projects Module (Post-Venta) Testing Complete. All features working: Backend APIs (15/15 tests passed), Frontend UI (all dialogs, stats, table, row expansion working). Projects are created automatically when a quote status changes to 'Enviada a Imple'. Settings page has 'Correo Gerente de Implementación' field.

issues: React hydration warning: <tr> cannot be child of <span>. This is a DOM nesting issue from React rendering wrapper, does not affect functionality.
